decision_scope: Results classify evidence for the tested model and path. Independent jobs continue after another job fails.

jobs.coverage: A40 F0 anchor readback, H200 serial equivalence and request isolation, admitted N=1/2 paired runtime throughput and available baseline arms.
requirements: Local Phase A admission for its own F2 comparison

jobs.coverage: Allocated and reserved peaks, N scan, admission model and observed capacity boundary at 768px.
Request-private eager and graph arms, persistent serial graph reuse, cold and repeat timing, different-K signature isolation checks.
requirements: F1 receipts classify evidence scope; the local serial comparison supports an independent diagnostic run

jobs.coverage: Native AsyncOmni baseline, dense service control and local paired runtime comparisons. FlashPS mechanism and compatibility are read back from its checked artifact.
The native worker baseline records actual request scheduling behavior.
remaining_requirements: Connect private executor, scheduler and capacity manager to vLLM-Omni active request set
Trace actual async worker overlap and isolated outputs
Exercise shutdown, failure cleanup and queue or serial fallback

jobs.coverage: N=1/2/4/8 FLUX 768px calibration scaling with distinct private paths and bounded capacity scan.
remaining_requirements: Freeze a full-source concurrent cohort and collect at least 24 sources with two repetitions for formal p99
Provide compatible dense and standard sparse multi-request paths for any additional arms

jobs.coverage: FLUX 1024px native dense calibration timing and memory. Dense configuration probes are separate from the 768px sparse path.
remaining_requirements: Freeze 1024px sparse traces with matching token geometry and scheduler
Verify 1024px sparse N=1 and a concurrent point with 1024px isolation and capacity

jobs.coverage: FLUX 768px frozen K=460 single-request Direct, calibrated Standard and Full, 48 held-out sources and two repetitions per arm.
requirements: Optional formal FLUX archive and SHA-256 sidecar
FLUX.1 Kontext Dev files matching frozen model hashes
remaining_requirements: Collect dense fastops, compile or graph as separate verified arms if implemented
Align dense reference images and score on a separate machine

jobs.coverage: Native dense resolution comparison and frozen FLUX sparse 20% point.
remaining_requirements: Freeze source-specific FLUX 10%, 35%, 50% and 1024px masks
Freeze protocol and regenerate matching traces for any warmup, refresh, CFG or step sensitivity point

jobs.coverage: Independent 1024px native dense LongCat and Qwen baselines on the selected H200 with resident placement.
remaining_requirements: Port or stage each model's verified sparse implementation and its complete matching assets
Validate Qwen sparse execution with one H200 and no model offload
Integrate the model-specific private executor and pass request isolation for sparse concurrent variants

jobs.coverage: First request, repeated-case cache hit, different same-shape cases, misses, capture counts, private eager or graph cost, and structural K signatures.
remaining_requirements: Freeze multiple K traces and control template pool capacity before a full K-by-capacity timing sweep

jobs.coverage: GPU stages retain outputs, available latent and velocity witnesses, PNG hashes and numerical admission results. Timed execution excludes metric scoring.
remaining_requirements: Join matched dense and optimized PNGs by model, source, repetition and protocol
Evaluate LPIPS, PSNR, SSIM and CLIP away from the reserved GPU
Preserve exact-lane and arithmetic-changing comparisons

jobs.coverage: Session command list, per-stage logs and receipts, raw images and available timeline records, artifact hashes, device and environment.
requirements: Preserve original outputs and include complete receipt links when returning the session

jobs.coverage: Synthetic GPU comparison at K=460, hidden=3072, MLP=12288 and N=1/2/4. Runtime packing gains require actual stage profiling and end-to-end validation.
Existing stage timings and timelines can identify step imbalance.
remaining_requirements: Implement and validate an isolated step-type-aware scheduler comparison if stage imbalance is observed

jobs.coverage: Frozen FLUX trajectory replay supplies a fixed external mask for the existing protocol.
remaining_requirements: Specify and validate a model-specific external mask adapter across additional policies and boundaries

jobs.coverage: Discuss active versus queued KV lifetimes using the resident capacity evidence, consistent with the original plan.
